commands.cmd:
python3 -c '
from pathlib import Path
phrase = "pending merge - NOT INSTALLED"
entries = ("lease-heartbeat", "anchor-timer", "upstream-health-poller")
sources = sorted(Path("prompts").glob("bot-*.xml"))
assert len(sources) == 7, len(sources)
for p in sources:
    text = p.read_text()
    assert text.count(phrase) == 4, (p.name, text.count(phrase))
    for entry in entries:
        assert text.count(f"id=\"{entry}\"") == 1, (p.name, entry)
    assert "grokbot/skills/desk-substrate-memory/SKILL.md" in text
    assert "grokbot/skills/swarm-v2-1/SKILL.md" in text
    has_tool = "<tooling>" in text
    expect = p.name in {"bot-05-infrastructure.xml", "bot-06-quality-security.xml"}
    assert has_tool is expect, (p.name, has_tool)
    if has_tool:
        assert "https://github.com/swcstudiospace/purple-team" in text
        assert "https://github.com/swcstudiospace/omes-bot" in text
for seat in ("LEAD", "SYSTEMS", "WEB", "ANDROID", "IOS", "INFRA", "QUALITY"):
    for folder in ("prompts", "prompts-assembled"):
        t = Path(folder, f"{seat}.xml").read_text()
        assert t.count(phrase) == 4, (folder, seat)
        assert "{{" not in t, (folder, seat)
print("content ok: 7 sources phrase x4; tooling on INFRA and QUALITY only; assembled copies match that count")
'
